subject: How can I use previous account to login?

messages.author: 0d918df190bdea9f
messages.subject: How can I use previous account to login?
parts: ShinyApps has a new website and it requires Google/Github account to sign in. However, I had an account a few months ago and the links to the apps I deployed before are still available. How can I use my previous account to login? If not, how can I link the Github account with my previous ShinyApps account?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How can I use previous account to login?
parts:
If you previously used Google to login to ShinyApps with the old UI, you just need to login again by selecting "Login with Google".

-Andy
